events.summary:
* WHAT...Southwest winds 20 to 25 kt with isolated gusts up to 30
kt and seas 6 to 9 feet expected.

* WHERE...Pohnpei Coastal Waters.

* WHEN...From 3 AM Wednesday to 3 PM ChST Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Invest 92W continues to slowly strengthen
northwest of Pohnpei. This tropical disturbance will lift
northwest over the next 24 hours or so. As this occurs, a
burgeoning wind field may develop, with sustained winds or
frequent gusts exceeding 22 knots by sunrise Wednesday morning,
which could potentially affect the region through Thursday
afternoon.
